description: MainActivity.java for an Android app demonstrating fingerprint authentication, key management, and encryption.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling fingerprint authentication, key creation, and encryption.

classes.name: PurchaseButtonClickListener
classes.description: Inner class handling purchase button click events, initiating fingerprint authentication.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes key store, cipher, UI, and fingerprint setup.

methods.name: initCipher
methods.description: Initializes cipher with stored key for encryption.

methods.name: onPurchased
methods.description: Handles post-authentication purchase logic, encrypting data if fingerprint used.

methods.name: showConfirmation
methods.description: Displays confirmation message and encrypted data.

methods.name: tryEncrypt
methods.description: Attempts to encrypt a secret message with the cipher.

methods.name: createKey
methods.description: Creates a symmetric key in Android KeyStore, optionally invalidated by biometric enrollment.
